answer: Epoch-Linked Behavioural Fingerprint. Each identity publishes a per-epoch action vector; reputation accrues only when consecutive epochs stay correlated above a threshold. A clone fleet cannot cheaply forge a coherent history, since faking continuity forces every copy to share one costly behavioural thread. Detectors flag sudden divergence as a hollow history. Attacker cost: sustained synchronous actions across every epoch, multiplying coordination and transaction expense per identity.
